resources.name: Quantum ESPRESSO

access.notes: Open-source plane-wave DFT code; used as alternative to VASP for all total-energy and property calculations.

resources.notes: DFT engine for geometry optimization, electronic structure, phonons, AIMD, elastic constants, and adsorption energies.

resources.name: Phonopy

access.notes: Phonon analysis tool using the finite-displacement method, interfaced with Quantum ESPRESSO.

resources.notes: Used to compute phonon dispersion and dynamic stability.

resources.name: SSSP Precision Pseudopotentials

access.notes: Standard PBE PAW pseudopotentials for Fe, Mn, V, S, and H.

resources.notes: PBE-PAW pseudopotentials from the SSSP library (or equivalent GBRV set) for all required elements.
